name: TwistingData.exists_projector
summary: Average the Frobenius-twisted generic operator over Levi-invariant means: Z(m) applies the tensor product of an N-tuple m of linear forms (exists_tensor_dual) to frobOperator T r ℓ n (frobGenericMatrix). With the mean κ_P (exists_mean, one per letter) and the invariant diagonal form b₀ (exists_invariant_diagonal_form), Z' = Z(−κ_False + κ_True)·diag(b'). Key (step 6): if the tuple m is the conjugate of a tuple l by a Levi element g (m_j = l_j ∘ conjSubst(ι_j, g)) and the coefficient condition H holds — for every row β at which the coefficient of the translate of y is not in w^c·O (the contributing rows; the others are disposed of by `dite` at line 174) and every monomial ν, either the product of the values of l at the letters vanishes or ν satisfies the hypotheses of pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator (equal row and column indexWeight-weights at every letter j ≠ i, and a gap strictly greater than 2c + 1 at i between the excess of β at i + ℓ and the row weight of ν) — then y·Z(m)F ∈ w^c·O (frobOperator_map, pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator). Levi invariance of the tuple alone does not give this: evaluation at the identity matrix in every letter is invariant, it sends the generic Frobenius operator to the identity matrix, and then the pairing y·Z(m)F = y·F can be 1. The means κ chosen by exists_mean supply H for the rows needed (their properties h1, h2). Expanding multilinearly over the letters, only the all-κ_True term survives modulo w^c, and it is p^{(k+k²)o₀N·N}·(y·F) by hz; the congruence (ii) is tested on y in the excess condition at θ − (4c + 2).

steps.claim: Take the multilinear S of exists_tensor_dual (ι = ℤ/N, σ = Fin k × Fin k) with its property hS; record q: (N·n·k(ℓ+2) + n + k + 1)·P^ℓ ≤ P^N (h multiplied by P^ℓ, with ℓ + ℓ = N); and take b₀, the invariant diagonal form of exists_invariant_diagonal_form for σ = Fin k, the prime p and f = o₀N (hb, hx).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨S, hS⟩, q, b₀, hb, hx⟩ := exists_tensor_dual (ZMod N) (Fin k × Fin k) O, e ▸ Nat.pow_add
    .. ▸ Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h, exists_invariant_diagonal_form (Fin k) T.prime hp (T.o₀ * N)

steps.claim: Let b(β) = Π_s b₀(β_s) for families β.
steps.lean: let b (β : ZMod N → Monomials _ n) := ∏ s, b₀ (β s).1

steps.claim: Choose b'(β) with b(β)·b'(β) = Π_s p^{k·o₀N} (each b₀(β_s) divides p^{k·o₀N}, as |β_s| = n < q).
steps.lean:
choose b' hb' using fun β ↦ (prod_dvd_prod_of_dvd _ _ fun s _ ↦
    Dvd.intro_left _ (hb _ (by grind [Monomials.degree_eq])).symm : b β ∣ _)

steps.claim: Claim hν: S(l)(f) = Σ_{ν ∈ support f} f_ν·Π_j l_j(x^{ν_j}) (ν_j = ν.curry j).
steps.lean:
have hν l f : S l f = ∑ ν ∈ f.support, f.coeff ν * ∏ j, l j (monomial (ν.curry j) 1) :=
    (congrArg _ f.as_sum).trans (by simp [← hS, monomial_eq, C_mul'])
steps.typed_fact: S l f = ∑ ν ∈ f.support, f.coeff ν * ∏ j, l j (monomial (ν.curry j) 1)

steps.claim: Let Z(m) be the matrix obtained by applying the linear form S(m) entrywise to frobOperator T r ℓ n (frobGenericMatrix T) (a multilinear map in the tuple m).
steps.lean:
let Z := ((LinearMap.mapMatrixLinear O).flip
    (T.frobOperator r ℓ n T.frobGenericMatrix)).compMultilinearMap S

steps.claim: Claim key: for a letter i, tuples m, l of linear forms with m_j = l_j ∘ conjSubst(ι_j, g) for g in the Levi subgroup (hg, e), and H (for all β and ν: a product of values vanishes, or the hypotheses e, g of pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator hold): y·(Z(m)·F) ∈ w^c·O for all y, F.
steps.lean:
have key i {m} (l : type_of% m) {g y F} (hg : g ∈ _) (e : ∀ j f, m j f = l j (conjSubst (T.ι j) g
    f)) (H : ∀ β _ ν, univ.prod _ = (0 : O) ∨ _) : y ⬝ᵥ Z m *ᵥ F ∈ span {T.w ^ c} := (by
    rw [(congr(.map _ $(show _ = _ ∘ₗ (aeval _).toLinearMap by
      ext; simp [single_eq_monomial, hν m, e]
      simp [← hS, monomial_eq])) : Z _ = .map (.map ((T.map C).frobOperator _ _ _ _) (eval₂Hom C
      fun (j, v) ↦ rename (j, ·) (conjSubst (T.ι j) g (X v)))) (S l)), frobOperator_map _ _ hg]
    simp_rw [letterRep_map, map_C_mul_mul_C, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec y, funext (hν l)]
    exact sum_mem fun β _ ↦ dite _ (mul_mem_right _ _) fun q ↦ mem_span_singleton.2 (.mul_left
      (dvd_sum fun _ _ ↦ .mul_right (dvd_sum fun ν _ ↦ (H β q ν).elim (· ▸ by simp) (And.elim
      (T.pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator ha i (by lia) (by lia) g (by simp [letterConj, conjSubst,
      linSubst, ← C_mul', map, map_mul,
      mul_apply, mul_assoc, mul_comm (X _)])) · |>.mul_right _)) _) _))
steps.typed_fact: y ⬝ᵥ Z m *ᵥ F ∈ span {T.w ^ c}

steps.claim: Rewrite Z(m) as S(l) applied entrywise to frobOperator of T over O[x] evaluated at the conjugated generic matrices, and apply frobOperator_map (conjugation by the Levi element).
steps.lean:
rw [(congr(.map _ $(show _ = _ ∘ₗ (aeval _).toLinearMap by
      ext; simp [single_eq_monomial, hν m, e]
      simp [← hS, monomial_eq])) : Z _ = .map (.map ((T.map C).frobOperator _ _ _ _) (eval₂Hom C
      fun (j, v) ↦ rename (j, ·) (conjSubst (T.ι j) g (X v)))) (S l)), frobOperator_map _ _ hg]

steps.claim: S(m) = S(l) ∘ (the substitution x_{(j,v)} ↦ conjSubst(ι_j, g)(x_v) in the variables of letter j), checked on monomials with hν and e.
steps.lean:
show _ = _ ∘ₗ (aeval _).toLinearMap by
      ext; simp [single_eq_monomial, hν m, e]
      simp [← hS, monomial_eq])) : Z _ = .map (.map ((T.map C).frobOperator _ _ _ _) (eval₂Hom C
      fun (j, v) ↦ rename (j, ·) (conjSubst (T.ι j) g (X v)))) (S l)), frobOperator_map _ _ hg]

steps.claim: Pull the constant conjugating matrices out (letterRep_map, map_C_mul_mul_C) and expand with hν.
steps.lean: simp_rw [letterRep_map, map_C_mul_mul_C, ← mulVec_mulVec, dotProduct_mulVec y, funext (hν l)]

steps.claim: Each term is divisible by w^c: either its product of values vanishes (H) or w^c divides the coefficient of the frobOperator entry (pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator at the letter i, with ha, ℓ ≤ N, N·n·k(ℓ+2) ≤ P^ℓ, and the conjugated generic matrices matching hψ).
steps.lean:
exact sum_mem fun β _ ↦ dite _ (mul_mem_right _ _) fun q ↦ mem_span_singleton.2 (.mul_left
      (dvd_sum fun _ _ ↦ .mul_right (dvd_sum fun ν _ ↦ (H β q ν).elim (· ▸ by simp) (And.elim
      (T.pow_dvd_coeff_conj_frobOperator ha i (by lia) (by lia) g (by simp [letterConj, conjSubst,
      linSubst, ← C_mul', map, map_mul,
      mul_apply, mul_assoc, mul_comm (X _)])) · |>.mul_right _)) _) _))

steps.claim: For every proposition P and letter j choose the mean κ(P, j) of exists_mean (τ = twoBlock k r, ι = ι_j, the prime p, f = o₀N, D = N·n·k·(ℓ+2)·P^ℓ, weights indexWeight T ℓ a r, property P ∨ θ − (2c+1) < ·) with its properties h0 (invariance), h2 (unequal weights give 0), h1 (values), h3 (span).
steps.lean:
choose κ h0 h2 h1 h3 using fun P j ↦ exists_mean (twoBlock k r) (T.ι j) T.prime hp (T.o₀ * N)
    (by grind) (D := N * (n * (k * ((ℓ + 2) * T.P ^ ℓ)))) (by grind [card_residueField])
    (T.indexWeight ℓ a r) (P ∨ θ - (2 * c + 1) < ·)

steps.claim: Take b and Z' = Z(−κ_False + κ_True)·diag(b'). (i): for F, g in the Levi subgroup and β with excess > θ at the letter i, key at the letter i − ℓ for the invariant tuple −κ_False + κ_True (h0) gives the divisibility, its hypothesis H coming from h1 and h2. (ii) and (iii) remain.
steps.lean:
use b, Z (-κ False + κ True) * diagonal b', fun F g hg β ⟨i, hi⟩ ↦ mulVec_mulVec F (Z _) _ ▸
    key (i - ℓ) (-κ False + κ True) hg (by simp [h0 _ _ g hg]) (by
    simp [one_apply]
    clear * - h1 h2 hi; grind [zero_mem]), fun y hy F ↦ ?_, ?ρ

steps.claim: Use (iii) (proved last) as a hypothesis.
steps.lean: have := ?ρ

steps.claim: Let Y(m) = (b·y)·(Z(m)·(b'·F)), a multilinear form in m.
steps.lean: let Y := (dotProductBilin O O (b * y) ∘ₗ toLin'.1.flip (b' * F)).compMultilinearMap Z

steps.claim: Claim hz: Z(κ_True) = (a constant)·(frobOperator evaluated at the identity matrix).
steps.lean:
have hz : Z (κ True) = (_ :
    O) • (T.frobOperator r ℓ n T.frobGenericMatrix).map
      (eval (vec (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) O) ·.2)) :=
    ext fun _ _ ↦ by
    simp [Z, hν, eval_eq']; congr! 1
    simp [h1, T.degree_le_of_coeff_frobOperator (mem_support_iff.1 ‹_›), eval_monomial]
    rw [mul_left_comm]
steps.typed_fact:
Z (κ True) = (_ :
    O) • (T.frobOperator r ℓ n T.frobGenericMatrix).map
      (eval (vec (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) O) ·.2))

steps.claim: Entrywise, expand Z with hν and evaluation at the identity.
steps.lean:
ext fun _ _ ↦ by
    simp [Z, hν, eval_eq']; congr! 1

steps.claim: κ_True takes the value p^{k²f}·(value at 1) on every monomial occurring, as all have degree ≤ D (degree_le_of_coeff_frobOperator) (h1).
steps.lean: simp [h1, T.degree_le_of_coeff_frobOperator (mem_support_iff.1 ‹_›), eval_monomial]

steps.claim: Reorder the product.
steps.lean: rw [mul_left_comm]

steps.claim: At the identity frobOperator is the identity matrix (frobOperator_map with h = 1), so Z(κ_True) = p^{…}·1; simplify hb' accordingly.
steps.lean:
simp [↓T.frobOperator_map _ (one_mem _), frobOperator, one_apply,
    T.prime.ne_zero, ite_apply, ← diagonal.eq_1, @eq_comm (Fin k)] at hz hb'

steps.claim: (ii): expand Y(−κ_False + κ_True) multilinearly over the subsets of letters (map_add_univ); the term with κ_True at every letter is p^{(k+k²)o₀N·N}·(y·F); it suffices that every other term lies in w^c·O, by induction on the set of letters carrying −κ_False.
steps.lean:
convert (mem_span_singleton.1 (sum_mem (Finset.induction (by simp) fun s t _ _ _ ↦ ?_))).trans
    (sub_eq_of_eq_add' ((Y.map_add_univ (-κ False) (κ True)).trans
    (sum_eq_add_sum_compl ∅ _))).symm.dvd

steps.claim: The main term, by hz and hb'; and the base case.
steps.lean: simp [Y]; ac_rfl; simp [Y, hz, add_mul]; grind

steps.claim: Induction step: insert the letter s.
steps.lean: rw [piecewise_insert]

steps.claim: κ_False at s lies in the span of the forms l∘conjSubst(u) (u in the Levi subgroup, l vanishing where the property fails) (h3); so it suffices that key applies to each generator (with the tuple updated at s).
steps.lean:
refine neg_mem (Submodule.mem_span.1 (h3 _ s) (.comap (Y.toLinearMap _ s) (span _)) fun
    | _, ⟨u, h, γ, e, rfl⟩ => And.elim (key s (update (t.piecewise (-κ False) (κ True)) s γ) h) ?_)

steps.claim: z: for every β, b(β)·(the translate of y by transposeGL(u⁻¹)) lies in w^c·O at β, by hy (u⁻¹ is in the Levi subgroup) for excess > θ − (4c+2).
steps.lean:
have z β := (mul_mem_left _ (b β) <|
    hy (transposeGL u⁻¹) (swap (inv_mem h · · ·.symm)) β ⟨s + ℓ, ·⟩)

steps.claim: Combine z with (iii), h0 and h2 to verify H for key.
steps.lean: simp [update, piecewise, DFunLike.ite_apply] at z ⊢; clear * - z e h0 h2 h this; grind

steps.claim: (iii): unfold ρ = ⊗_s Sym^n(g_s) and b = Π_s b₀; it suffices letter by letter.
steps.lean: simp [letterRep, kroneckerPi, b, ← prod_mul_distrib]

steps.claim: Letter by letter this is the transposition identity of b₀ (hx), letterMatrix of γᵀ being the transpose of that of γ.
steps.lean: congr! 1; erw [mul_comm, letterMatrix]; bound
